reviews.title: Fraldas descartáveis para cães incontinentes
reviews.body:
De imensas marcas que já experimentei, são as primeiras fraldas 100% eficazes! Para quem tem um cão incontinente sabe do que falo, infelizmente é uma realidade e uma experiência super desagradável, além de ter a despesa de comprar fraldas, a expectativa é que funcionem!, Não há pior do que ter de estar sempre a endireitar a fralda, ensoparem e começar a sair para fora, etc etc..
Estou mesmo muito muito contente com estas fraldas, super adaptáveis, super absorventes, recomendo!

reviews.title: These are the BEST! They work!
reviews.body: My miniature poodle is now a very old boy and he still enjoys all the doggy things he's always loved BUT...... he doesn't always manage to get into the garden in time when he needs a 'wee'. I decided to try him with nappies and experimented with different brands. We still had a few accidents until I realised that I needed to make sure his little 'tinkler' was tucked into the nappy. Even then, some nappy brands still leaked; being a bit too small, too narrow or too little padding. These PETSOFT ones are perfect and I buy them in bulk!! He doesn't mind wearing them and as long as I get down on my knees to check that I've placed the nappy behind his 'tinkler' and then tightened it snugly round him, and then we relax. If he's dashed to the door to get out for a 'wee', they can be whipped off quickly and reapplied once he's back in. These doggy nappies make my life with my old dog so much easier and I don't have to worry about any possible accidents.
reviews.date: Reseñado en el Reino Unido el 2 de junio de 2025
